title: Backlog-era live instructions remain in lore-cli docs after LCLI-574
description: Found by the LCLI-574 implementer's sweep of docs/ (opum-ai/lore-cli#272). These are live instructions, not history, and were outside LCLI-574's two target passages: (1) docs/runbooks/lore-cli-handover.md:25 says 'Start at the documentation index', and the whole runbook is from the Backlog era ('backlog instructions overview', 'the Backlog CLI'). It needs a rewrite against Quest and the opum-handoff skill, or a retirement. (2) docs/reference/operate-autonomous-lore-cli-documentation-campaigns.md:76 says '$backlog-handover restore', and :81 names the opum-worktrees skill, which was deleted 2026-09-04; parts of it assume Backlog throughout. (3) docs/runbooks/agent-onboarding.md's quick-reference row says 'lore link ... lore commits' (true only on Backlog, per LCLI-573), and two places say it 'drives backlog --json'. Retirement scope applies: fix live instruction, leave dated history alone.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Each listed passage either describes current behaviour (Quest backend, opum-handoff, no lore commits on Quest) or is removed as retired, verified against source or lore instructions
A grep of docs/ for backlog-handover, opum-worktrees and backlog --json returns only history or product-surface hits, each listed in the PR body

plan: Verify per-backend behaviour in src/: tracker selection (src/tracker-selection.ts), commit decision (src/tracker-persistence.ts, src/commands/link.ts commitFileFor), what lore tasks invokes per adapter (src/adapters/quest.ts, backlog.ts, jira.ts), init's tracker probe (src/commands/init.ts)

Rewrite docs/runbooks/lore-cli-handover.md in place as a short pointer to opum-handoff restore against Quest; keep the path so its six inbound links stay true (lore graph shows they all describe it as a cursor-free fresh-session route)

Rewrite the Backlog/Codex-era parts of docs/reference/operate-autonomous-lore-cli-documentation-campaigns.md: authority source, delegation roles, opum-handoff init/restore/cursor, plain branch plus explicit isolation parameter, drop retired lease and cursor-audit limits
Make docs/runbooks/agent-onboarding.md backend-accurate: loop diagram, Step 3, init probe, 2.3/2.4, guardrails, quick-reference rows and Related list; leave Backlog product-surface links intact
Run /usr/bin/grep -rn over docs/ for backlog-handover, opum-worktrees and 'backlog --json'; classify every hit and count files scanned
Run bun run lore sync if needed and bun run lore check to exit 0; commit, push, record evidence and final summary
implementationNotes: Source facts behind the rewrite. Selection: src/tracker-selection.ts:51-60 (explicit tracker.backend wins; a real Backlog project with no key is refused by createConfiguredTrackerAdapter, src/adapters/tracker.ts:116-121; otherwise Quest). Init: wizard default 'quest' (src/commands/init.ts:1594), bare path persists quest (init.ts:588), probe runs against the SELECTED backend (init.ts:150-160). Commit: src/tracker-persistence.ts:65-86 commits only for backlog, NO_COMMIT otherwise; link.ts:173 commitFileFor collapses non-backlog files to null; link/unlink/sync/rename all use resolveSelectedBackend. lore tasks: probe then viewTask per id (src/commands/tasks.ts:161-170) -> quest task view <id> --json (src/adapters/quest.ts:437, probe runs manifest --json at :397 after the MIN_QUEST_VERSION 0.2.7 floor), backlog task view <id> --json (src/adapters/backlog.ts:964, MIN_BACKLOG_VERSION 1.49.0), jira issue get <id> (src/adapters/jira.ts:203; --version presence check only, no floor). Actor env vars and exit 6: bun run lore instructions linking.

Handover decision: rewrite in place as a short pointer, not rename/supersede. lore graph shows 6 inbound links (index, runbooks index via index, lore-cli-documentation-ownership, lore-cli-release-truth, stories/maintain-lore-cli-documentation-authority, two historical-* references); every live one describes it as a cursor-free fresh-session route, which the pointer keeps true without editing out-of-scope files. opum-handoff facts read from the installed opum-workflow 0.10.8 SKILL.md and references/restore.md, init.md. LCLI-253 and LCLI-278 are Done, so the 'live owner gates' line was stale.

Out-of-scope finding for the dispatcher: CLAUDE.md's Delegation section says documenter 'ships with no Bash', but installed opum-workflow 0.10.8 (installed_plugins.json) lists 'tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Edit, Write, Bash, Skill' in agents/documenter.md. CLAUDE.md is outside this task's scope; not edited.

AC1 evidence (commit 6db07bdf): handover route now opum-handoff restore + Quest; campaigns doc now CLAUDE.md, opum-handoff init/write/restore, plain branch + explicit isolation parameter, hook-written cursor.md; onboarding states per-backend reads and commits. Each claim traced to src/ or lore instructions linking in the note above.

AC2 evidence: /usr/bin/grep -rn -e backlog-handover -e opum-worktrees -e 'backlog --json' docs -> 3 lines in 2 files of 83 files scanned (82 .md). All history: stories/build-the-lore-cli-foundation.md:193 (LCLI-319 row, Done task table), stories/maintain-lore-cli-documentation-authority.md:55 and :60 (LCLI-292, LCLI-328 rows, Done task tables, lore-managed). Positive control: the same patterns on the three target files at origin/dev return 4 hits (campaigns:40,76,81; onboarding:114); now 0.
AC3 evidence: bun run lore check (lore from source) -> '82 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings, 9 out-of-bundle links skipped', exit 0.
finalSummary:
Retired the Backlog-era live instructions in three docs on branch lcli-589-backlog-era-docs. lore-cli-handover.md is rewritten in place as a short pointer to opum-handoff restore against Quest, kept at its path because its six inbound links still describe it truly. operate-autonomous-lore-cli-documentation-campaigns.md now uses CLAUDE.md, opum-handoff init/write/restore, a plain branch plus an explicit isolation parameter, and the hook-written cursor, and it drops the lease and cursor-audit machinery. agent-onboarding.md states per backend what lore tasks reads and what lore link commits, verified in src/. The AC2 grep leaves 3 history-only hits in Done task tables. bun run lore check exits 0. The PR is opened by the dispatching session.

Delivered in opum-ai/lore-cli#284. Parent session re-verified before closing: tracker-persistence commits only on backlog, the legacy-backlog validation refusal, the AC2 grep (same 3 history hits) and bun run lore check (82 files, 0 errors, exit 0).
